name: DPO Pay

status.webhook_verification: None — DPO has no signed webhook. RedirectURL/BackURL are browser redirects and are NOT proof of payment. Poll verifyToken server-side (must verify within 30 min of payment) as the source of truth.

credentials_required.label: Company Token (GUID)
credentials_required.note: single token sent in every XML body; identifies the merchant account. No API key/secret pair — DPO has none.

credentials_required.label: Service Type ID
credentials_required.note: provisioned service id(s) for the account; sandbox demo uses 3854/5525.

credentials_required.label: Environment (sandbox/live)
credentials_required.note: selects sandbox vs live host + API base.

test_credentials.note: public demo token/service pre-wired; build before your own KYC clears, swap the real token via config at cutover with zero code change.

sandbox.notes: Test cards are NOT public — they are issued with a test account; request from DPO support, never hardcode. Mobile-money sandbox returns simulated instructions via GetMobilePaymentOptions + chargeTokenMobile.

pain_points.problem: XML API in a JSON world
pain_points.cause: DPO's only API (API3G) is XML request/response with no JSON option
pain_points.mitigation: Hide XML entirely behind ManishaPay's JSON contract — hand-built buildXml()/parseXml() are the only tag-aware code; the merchant POSTs and receives JSON

pain_points.problem: Company Token onboarding delay, no self-serve portal
pain_points.cause: KYC-gated; token issued by sales (sales1@dpogroup.com) over days-to-weeks
pain_points.mitigation: Merchant builds against DPO's public sandbox demo token pre-wired in test mode; swap the real token via config at cutover — zero code change

pain_points.cause: DPO never pushes a signed callback; RedirectURL is a best-effort browser redirect and payment must be verified within 30 min or an alert email fires
pain_points.mitigation: Run verifyToken server-side on a poll loop and emit a single normalized ManishaPay webhook; never gate fulfilment on the browser redirect

pain_points.cause: createToken returns 000 for token CREATED (not paid) while verifyToken 000 means paid; 001 is authorised-not-captured
pain_points.mitigation: Interpret 000 by call site; map verifyToken 001 -> pending (never paid) and 900 -> pending; collapse all codes to the 5 canonical statuses

pain_points.cause: Mobile-money charge requires exact MNO+country strings (e.g. MTNZM/Zambia, Safaricom STK v2/Kenya)
pain_points.mitigation: Call GetMobilePaymentOptions first and maintain an MNO->country lookup before chargeTokenMobile

pain_points.cause: Both /API/v6/ and /API/v7/ are live with subtly different behaviour
pain_points.mitigation: Pin one tested version (V6) internally and upgrade deliberately after re-testing

notes: XML-only 'API3G'. Single CompanyToken (UUID) authenticates every call — no OAuth, no request signing, no signed webhook. Flow: createToken -> redirect payv3.php?ID=<TransToken> -> verifyToken (poll). No native 'refunded' status: refunds go via refundToken (partial OK) and must be tracked in your own ledger. Recurring/mobile charging (chargeTokenCreditCard/chargeTokenMobile/chargeTokenAuth) is per-merchant entitlement. Currencies are provisioned per merchant, not a public list.
